# AMMR Body Model Development Instructions



<!-- --------------------------------------------------- -->
## Focus Areas

All key objects in the focus areas should be carefully defined and structured to ensure consistency and accuracy in the body model development.
Furthermore, usability and maintainability should be considered when defining and structuring these objects.

- Clear hierarchy
- Consistent structure
- Good naming, that clearly conveys the purpose and role of the object
- Proper documentation
  - Documentation-comments associated with the object that further explain the purpose and usage of the object.
  - Conceptual documentation as part of the Sphinx AMMR documentation that explains the high-level design and rationale behind the object or the collection it is part of.
